name: Neural Recording, Imaging & Stimulation
summary: The tools for reading and writing brain activity (electrodes, EEG, imaging, optogenetics, stimulation) that underpin neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces.

topics.name: Electrophysiology fundamentals: patch clamp and intracellular recording
Extracellular recording, microelectrode arrays and high-density probes
Local field potentials, ECoG and intracranial EEG
Scalp EEG and MEG: sources, artefacts and preprocessing
Functional imaging: fMRI BOLD and fNIRS
Optical methods: calcium and voltage imaging, two-photon microscopy
Electrical stimulation: DBS, TMS, tDCS and intracortical microstimulation
Electrode-tissue interface: biocompatibility, gliosis and signal longevity
